question: Who among the following was awarded the Padma Shri for the contributions in Kathak?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sunayana Hazarilal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sunayana Hazarilal** is a renowned **Kathak dancer **who has contributed significantly to the **art form.**
 
• She is purportedly the** last** living practitioner of **Kathak's Janakiprasad Gharana,** popularly referred to as the Banares Gharana.
 
• She has been awarded the** Padma Shri**, one of the highest civilian awards in India, for her contributions in Kathak in **2011.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sarodi Saikia** is an **Assamese-born** Indian classical dancer, teacher, and chetar player.

 
 
• Her **Sattriya dance** has brought her the most fame. In **2015**, Saikia was awarded the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award.**
 
 
 
• **Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan** is a folk artist from** Assam.**
 
 
• He is associated with **Sattriya dance.**
 
 
 
• **Jogen Dutta Bayan** is a folk artist from Assam 
 
 
• He has been awarded **Sangeet Natak Akademi.**
